'''''Lundi''''' was a [[Cargo ferry]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
When [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[Clan leader]] [[Tamaron]] agreed to replenish the Rebel's [[Warhead/Legends|Warhead]] supply he arranged the transfer to take place at [[The Drift/Legends|The Drift]]. '''Lundi''' along with sister ship ''[[Orrian]]'' and [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] [[Condor (MC40a light cruiser)|''Condor'']] arrived to pick up the warheads. However as this was going on [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from rival Airam clan leader and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] collaborator [[Ilay]] would arrive to attack the [[Asteroid/Legends|Asteroid]] [[Asteroid Hangar|Base]] ''[[Attila]]''. [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from both [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] fought of the T-wings and afterwards [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Wasp (Imperial-class)|''Wasp'']] long enough for the transfer to be completed and both Rebel and Airam ships to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
